newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's BUX closes officially at 5,872.39 pts.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's BUX closes officially at 5,872.39 pts.

text.p: The BUX index of the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) closed officially at 5,872.39 points on Wednesday, up 45.15 points or 0.77 percent, unchanged from the preliminary figures, the BSE said in a statement.
Spot share turnover totalled four billion forints, down from 4.33 billion forints on Tuesday.
The September maturity finished down by 3.50 points at 6508.50, while December 1998 dropped 5.00 points to 8,125.00.
Other maturities finished up by 3.50 to 40.00 points. The December 1997 maturity closed at 6,970.00 points, up 40.00.
